# Now I have the access token. Next, I need to get all transactions for this month so far (from the 1st of this month to today).
from datetime import datetime

# Get today's date and the first day of the month in YYYY-MM-DD format
today = datetime.now()
min_created_at = today.replace(day=1).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
max_created_at = today.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

# We'll fetch both sent and received transactions, so no direction filter.
# We'll start with the first page and set page_limit to 20 (max allowed).
transactions = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20

while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token="eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ2ZW5tbytqby1oYXJyQGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsImV4cCI6MTY4NDQxMjA5OH0.4kAHHBEgpO70h3jQRPMhEC-3T9ar14kiHiBCNVLKxYY",
        min_created_at=min_created_at,
        max_created_at=max_created_at,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    if not page or len(page) == 0:
        break
    transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(transactions)
